d:
I saw this artist on X and immediately fell in love, and I was pretty surprised to only see one single, fairly old gallery of their stuff. So I did some digging, scraped their X, Pixiv and Patreon, and the old galalery just in case, and made a new gallery that i'll try and keep updated. Anyone who routinely uploads art of Hiyori is aces in my book
Also, to the moron who thinks Giselle isn't a guy, Kubo himself confirmed that, yes, Yumichika and Charlotte were right on the money, and that Giselle is very much a man
